تضطبني (form VIII)
# تَضْطَبِنِي (taḍṭabinī) /tadˤ.tˤa.bi.niː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# تُضْطَبَنِي (tuḍṭabanī) /tudˤ.tˤa.ba.niː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
